messages:
mira: Kickoff for MIA region networking bring-up. Scope: Transit attachment to central TGW, NAT/egress, private DNS delegation, route propagation checks, and SRE handoff. Looking for owners and any blockers. Target cutover window: 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC. :rocket:
samir: I can own TGW peering + route table config. Quick Q: do we attach MIA to the central TGW or run a dedicated regional TGW? My preference is central TGW for consistent routing and fewer peering relationships. :eyes:
alex.g: +1 for central TGW. Cheaper and easier to manage. We need an ASN for MIA side when doing BGP with the transit. We use 64511 for core; propose 64513 for MIA. Also decide if we enforce BGP MD5 for the control plane sessions.
mira: Confirmed ASN 64513 for MIA. Enable MD5 on BGP sessions (security requirement from infra). I'll spin up the infra ticket. Here's a minimal terraform example for the attach + route table we plan to use:
```hcl
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway" "core" {
  description = "redwood-core-tgw"
}
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment" "mia_attach" {
  transit_gateway_id = aws_ec2_transit_gateway.core.id
  vpc_id             = var.mia_vpc_id
  subnet_ids         = var.mia_subnet_ids
}
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table" "mia_rt" {
  transit_gateway_id = aws_ec2_transit_gateway.core.id
  tags = { Name = "mia-egress-rt" }
}
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route" "default_route" {
  destination_cidr_block         = "0.0.0.0/0"
  transit_gateway_route_table_id = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table.mia_rt.id
  transit_gateway_attachment_id   = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment.mia_attach.id
}
```
netops-bot: Scheduled TGW attach job for 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC (job-id: tgw-job-4231). Notifications will post here when propagation completes.
june: DNS note — we'll create a private hosted zone mia.redwood-inference.internal in Route53 and delegate from the org root internal zone. Need the NS records and the VPC associations. Who will create the route53 NS records in the registrar/parent account?
samir: I will handle the Route53 delegation and NS records. Plan: create private hosted zone in the prod account, then add NS set to org-internal zone in the infra-account. Cross-account role available for this.
alex.g: NAT/egress design: prefer managed NAT Gateways for initial bring-up (simplicity + AWS support). Cost callout: NAT GW + EIP costs can be significant. Alternative is autoscaling NAT instance fleet but that has more ops overhead. Recommendation: start with NAT GW, monitor, and Optimize will suggest caching/batching later to cut egress. Also remember to allocate EIPs from our EIP pool, request if quota is low.
mira: Agreed on NAT GW for initial. Cost estimate (rough): ~ $2k/month for small fleet for MIA egress. We'll track in the console per-route cost. Filing infra request for EIP quota check now.
oncall-sre: During cutover, run this quick verification sequence to confirm routes propagate and egress is healthy:
1) aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-route-tables --filters Name=transit-gateway-id,Values=tgw-1234567890
2) aws ec2 describe-transit-gateway-routes --transit-gateway-route-table-id tgw-rt-1111 | grep 0.0.0.0/0
3) from a bastion in MIA: curl -I https://status.redwood-inference.internal (expect 200)
Example output for step 2:
```json
{"Routes": [{"DestinationCidrBlock":"0.0.0.0/0","TransitGatewayAttachmentId":"tgw-attach-mia","State":"available"}]}
```
samir: Test checklist (short):
- [ ] Create TGW attachment and tag (owner: samir)
- [ ] Create/associate TGW route table + enable propagation (owner: samir)
- [ ] Allocate EIPs + create NAT Gateways in public subnets (owner: alex.g)
- [ ] Create private hosted zone + cross-account NS delegation (owner: june)
- [ ] Run smoke tests from control plane and MIA bastion (owner: oncall-sre)
- [ ] SRE runbook & handoff (owner: oncall-sre)
- [ ] Post-cutover cost monitoring (owner: finance/ops)
mira: Owners set as above. Blockers: EIP quota in prod account currently at 5, we need 8 for initial redundancies. Please confirm quota increase.
alex.g: Submitted quota increase request (id: request-54321) earlier today. AWS ETA ~48 hours. Will not allocate EIPs until it's approved to avoid partial allocations. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
june: I'll prepare the hosted zone and preregister the delegation records but will only flip the NS set once we confirm EIP allocation and NAT health.
oncall-sre: For the canary phase, plan to route 10% of traffic via MIA routes (via route propagation + blackhole detection). If anything fails fallback to core region using route priorities. We'll automate rollback via the rollout runbook.
samir: Small implementation detail — remember to disable Source/Destination check on NAT instances if we ever go that route. For TGW attachments, set the route table propagation to correct RT (mia-egress-rt) and tag with env/prov so console queries are easy.
mira: Scheduling cutover for 2026-03-22 03:00 UTC contingent on EIP quota approval and TGW job success. If approved earlier we'll move sooner. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when OK.
samir: :thumbsup:
